notes.title: BREAKING NEWS!
notes.content: Special message for all the Little Dipsters out there. Air Marty is now selling for only $2.99! A big thank you to everyone that bought it for $5, you'll always be my dear best sweeties. To those that didn't buy it, your patience paid off. notes.title: Air Marty Soundtrack out now!
notes.content:
The Air Marty soundtrack is available now on Bandcamp.! Featuring over 60 original tracks by semi-famous DJ Widdly 2 Diddly. https://airmarty.bandcamp.com/album/air-marty-soundtrack-an-evening-with-marty

Also a reminder that Air Marty is now available on OSX and Linux, and features steam achievements!
